command: Official Roblox Studio MCP: list_roblox_studios, get_studio_state, execute_luau (read-only), start_stop_play, character_navigation, user_keyboard_input

sourceIdentity.scope: Git-tracked and nonignored workspace files in their current working-tree contents, excluding evidence artifacts. This identifies the workspace snapshot at the time of the run; the loaded Studio place file itself was not hashed.

scenario.expected: Gather three Echoes, deposit them at the archive, select a route, activate both route plates, and observe one restoration.
scenario.outcome: Server-authoritative collection reached three Echoes, but the character navigation tool could not find a route from the north bank to the central archive. The archive remained at 0/3, no route was selected, and no restoration occurred.

steps.action: Confirmed the selected Studio instance was signal-garden-20261107-175946294.rbxlx in Edit mode; read-only Luau returned PlaceId 0 and GameId 0.
steps.result: Studio entered local Play with one player; read-only server inspection showed PlaceId 0, GameId 0, Echoes 0, Restorations 0, and the SignalGarden field present.

steps.action: Navigated to EchoFragment01 and checked the server-observed character-to-fragment distance before sending E for 400 ms.
steps.result: Distance was 7.575 studs. The server increased Echoes to 1, removed the SignalGardenEcho tag, set Collected true, hid the fragment, and disabled its prompt.

steps.action: Attempted EchoFragment02 through instance navigation and then an explicit nearby coordinate.
steps.result: Both tool calls returned success, but the server still observed distance about 20.64 studs and Echoes remained 1. This confirms tool-call success alone did not establish movement or interaction.

steps.action: After EchoFragment01 respawned, collected it twice more with normal E input and checked the server after each action.
steps.result: The server reported Echoes 2 and then 3; each collection removed the tag and disabled the prompt until respawn.

steps.action: Attempted navigation to ResonanceArchive, NorthRootBridge, and a coordinate on the bridge.
steps.result: Navigation to ResonanceArchive returned 'Can not find a route to the destination'. The later calls returned success but the server position stayed near (-7.33, 5.54, -70.55), so no deposit occurred.

steps.action: Stopped local Play and queried Studio state.
steps.result: Studio returned to Edit. No save or publish operation was made.

limitations: This is a failed navigation procedure, not evidence of a gameplay-code defect; the normal collection prompt and server inventory update worked.
The place file itself was not hashed, so this record binds the workspace snapshot and named local Studio place, not a verified build artifact identity.
No screenshot or console output was captured during this attempt.
Single-player desktop only; no multiplayer, touch/controller, physical-device, performance, visual-approval, or release certification.
